verdict.rationale: The Phaser Editor page says its AI/MCP tooling can "rename a bunch of objects" and "reorganise a scene into layers" in one go. That is the product's own capability touching on bulk changes across many scene items, but it rests on a single marketing line with no documented bulk-edit tool, scope, or limits. Missing for 10: documented bulk/batch operation tools or APIs, which item types and operations are supported, limits and error handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Create a particle emitter, reorganise a scene into layers, rename a bunch of objects — it handles it without switching tools.
For power users, the MCP Server goes deeper. It implements over 40 specialised tools
